changeSet.author: Víctor Cañizares

preConditions.onFailMessage: Cannot bind the active-token index of one_time_token to memberships: membership_id is missing, one_time_token_one_active_uq is missing or is not the original index, or one_time_token_membership_one_active_uq already exists. Inspect with: SELECT indexname, indexdef FROM pg_indexes WHERE tablename = 'one_time_token';
preConditions.sqlCheck: SELECT count(*) FROM pg_indexes WHERE tablename = 'one_time_token' AND indexname = 'one_time_token_one_active_uq' AND indexdef LIKE '%(user_id, purpose) WHERE ((used_at IS NULL) AND (revoked_at IS NULL))'
SELECT count(*) FROM pg_indexes WHERE tablename = 'one_time_token' AND indexname = 'one_time_token_membership_one_active_uq'

changeSet.sql: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX one_time_token_one_active_uq ON one_time_token (user_id, purpose) WHERE membership_id IS NULL AND used_at IS NULL AND revoked_at IS NULL
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX one_time_token_membership_one_active_uq ON one_time_token (membership_id) WHERE membership_id IS NOT NULL AND used_at IS NULL AND revoked_at IS NULL

rollback.sql: DELETE FROM one_time_token WHERE membership_id IS NOT NULL
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX one_time_token_one_active_uq ON one_time_token (user_id, purpose) WHERE used_at IS NULL AND revoked_at IS NULL
